author: Libor “Burny” Burian
method: Every final page rendered by Poppler at 150 DPI and visually inspected at original image resolution; pypdf text checks supplement, not replace, visual review.
automated_check_scope: Displayed Ant headline fields and numeric tokens from generated confirmation, hypothesis, clipping and cohort tables are present in extracted PDF text. This is not a fresh statistical reanalysis or an independent audit of upstream training metadata.
resolved_problem: Initial visual review found a wrong Delta glyph, and the separate audit review found missing alpha inside inline formulas. The renderer now spells Delta/alpha/delta/theta/omega in portable ASCII while preserving mathematical names and signs. Both PDFs were regenerated; every final paper page was reinspected.
renderer_environment_note: Poppler emits configuration warnings for unavailable display fonts, including Symbol. The final paper no longer depends on Symbol for Greek notation; no visible missing glyph remained in the inspected pages.
